name: footer-bold

frames.best_why: The contact heading, email, address columns plus the watermark and bottom bar are all clear.

tagline: An airy contact footer with a giant faded wordmark across it.
summary: A tall white page footer. It opens with an invitation and a big underlined email on the left, address and social columns on the right, then a huge pale brand name above a thin baseline with copyright and a back-to-top control.
appearance: A white full-height footer: a bold two-line invitation and large underlined email at top left, a Brooklyn address and social links in two small uppercase columns at top right. A very pale oversized wordmark fills the lower half above a thin rule and small copyright row.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves on its own. The email and social links only change colour or grow an underline when hovered.
demo_content: Email hello@example.com, 123 Creative Way in Brooklyn, and a UI-Layouts watermark.
search_phrases: footer with a huge faded wordmark
email and address at page bottom
minimal footer with city and links
footer with back to top link
use_when: An agency or portfolio page needs a generous closing block with a contact email and a strong brand mark.
avoid_when: The wordmark, email and address are fixed, and the huge watermark currently spells the library's own name.
customise: The heading, email, address, socials, watermark text and copyright are all written in the file; colours and spacing need source edits.
weight_why: A static page of text and links with no scripts or animation.

a11y.note: Links sit in a nav with a semantic address, but the Back to top control is a bare button with no handler, so it does nothing.

issues: The Back to top button has no click handler and does not scroll anywhere.
The oversized watermark is so faint it reads as a smudge rather than a brand mark.
polish_why: Clean Swiss-style spacing, but it is a plain footer and the watermark is barely legible.
title: Footer Bold
